# Lifehacker

> Lifehacker is a practical how-to and advice site covering technology, productivity, health, home improvement, and consumer product reviews to help readers do everything better.

Lifehacker provides actionable tips, product recommendations, tech news, and deals across lifestyle categories including smartphones, AI tools, privacy, fitness, gaming, and smart home devices. The site features expert reviews, comparisons, and hacks for both consumer technology and everyday life improvement.

## Key Topics

- Tech Deals
- AI Tools
- Privacy & Security
- Smartphones
- Product Reviews
- How-To Guides
- Wearables & Fitness Trackers
- Smart Home
- Mobile Apps
- Data Breaches
- VPNs
- Android & iOS
- Hardware Reviews
- Tech News
- Software Tips

## Latest & Core Content

- [Lifehacker Homepage](https://lifehacker.com): Homepage featuring latest stories, tech news, fitness guides, and deals
- [Latest Articles](https://lifehacker.com/latest): Latest articles covering tech, cooking, finance, and trending hacks from Lifehacker
- [Newsletters](https://lifehacker.com/newsletters): Newsletter subscription hub for daily tips, tech news, deals, and home improvement

## Technology & Reviews

- [Tech Section](https://lifehacker.com/tech): Tech news, reviews, and advice on smartphones, computers, and gadgets
- [Reviews](https://lifehacker.com/reviews): Product reviews for wearables, smartphones, fitness gadgets, and consumer electronics
- [Best Picks](https://lifehacker.com/best-picks): Curated product recommendations for gaming laptops, phones, TVs, and 2026 tech
- [Comparisons](https://lifehacker.com/comparisons): Product comparisons for smart glasses, VR headsets, fitness trackers, and wearables
- [AI Tips & Tools](https://lifehacker.com/tech/ai): AI tips, tools, and hacks for NotebookLM, Google Workspace, YouTube, and productivity
- [Hardware](https://lifehacker.com/tech/hardware): Hardware news, gaming devices, laptops, routers, and Windows PC gaming content
- [Software](https://lifehacker.com/tech/software): Software tips for Chrome, Word, VPN deals, and browser extension tutorials

## Privacy, Security & Mobile

- [Privacy & Security](https://lifehacker.com/tech/privacy): Privacy guides covering data breaches, VPNs, tracking prevention, and surveillance
- [Best Paid VPNs of 2025](https://lifehacker.com/tech/the-best-paid-vpns): In-depth review and comparison of best paid VPNs for streaming and privacy in 2025
- [Mobile Apps](https://lifehacker.com/tech/mobile-apps): Mobile app guides for Chrome, Signal, WhatsApp, iOS, Android, and parental controls

## Deals & Hacks

- [Deals](https://lifehacker.com/deals): Tech deals, product discounts, weekly roundups, and gadget sales from Lifehacker
- [Hacks & Tips](https://lifehacker.com/hacks): Tips and tricks for iPhone, Chrome, Signal app, and mobile app hacks

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Health & Fitness](https://lifehacker.com/health): Health section covering fitness advice, trackers, gym equipment, and sports recovery
- [Entertainment](https://lifehacker.com/entertainment): Entertainment hub with TV recommendations, streaming guides, and gaming content
- [Home & Garden](https://lifehacker.com/home): Home and garden advice on organizing, DIY improvements, gardening, and maintenance

## Hardware Guides

- [TVs](https://lifehacker.com/tech/tvs): TV deals and reviews for OLED, Samsung, Sony, and Hisense televisions
